title: A parameter with a default
prompt: The second parameter, bonus, has a default value of 10. The tests sometimes pass only one number. Return n plus bonus.
signature: func solve(n: int, bonus: int = 10) -> int:
starter:
func solve(n: int, bonus: int = 10) -> int:
	return n
hint: When the caller leaves a parameter out, it takes the default written after the = sign.
solution:
func solve(n: int, bonus: int = 10) -> int:
	return n + bonus
